glosses: that which has continuity or continuousness
that whose perception cannot be broken down into various distinct elementary perceptions

examples.text: Le ragazze lo dicono in continuo.
examples.en: Girls say that all the time.

examples.text: Continuo a venire qui ogni giorno.
examples.en: I still come here every day.

examples.text: La gente lo fa di continuo.
examples.en: People do it all the time.

examples.text: Continuo a non avere un lavoro.
examples.en: I still don't have a job.
